denominator_definition: AC power at the grid connection point
denominator_definition_zh: 并网点交流电功率
notes: Scale input; the simplified model is nearly scale-neutral.
notes_zh: 规模输入；简化模型近似规模中性。

display_name_zh: 太阳能至直流转换效率
denominator_definition: Incident solar power to space DC-bus output
denominator_definition_zh: 入射太阳功率至空间直流母线输出
notes: Architecture-dependent exploratory value; not an independently verified flight-system value.
notes_zh: 取决于架构的探索值；并非经独立验证的飞行系统数值。

denominator_definition: Space DC-bus input to emitted RF power
denominator_definition_zh: 空间直流母线输入至射频发射功率
notes: Excludes propagation and rectenna conversion losses.
notes_zh: 不含传播和整流天线转换损耗。

denominator_definition: Emitted RF power to RF incident on the rectenna
denominator_definition_zh: 射频发射功率至整流天线入射射频功率
notes: Simplified beam-capture proxy; beam geometry sidelobes weather and safety constraints are not explicitly modelled.
notes_zh: 简化的波束捕获代理；未显式建模波束几何旁瓣天气及安全约束。

display_name_zh: 整流天线射频至直流效率
denominator_definition: Incident RF power at rectenna to rectenna DC output
denominator_definition_zh: 整流天线入射射频功率至直流输出
notes: Exploratory system-average conversion proxy.
notes_zh: 探索性的系统平均转换代理。

denominator_definition: Rectenna DC output to AC at the grid connection point
denominator_definition_zh: 整流天线直流输出至并网点交流功率
notes: Includes simplified inversion and local electrical losses only.
notes_zh: 仅包含简化逆变及本地电气损耗。

denominator_definition: Annual AC energy divided by rated delivered AC capacity times 8760
denominator_definition_zh: 年度交流电量除以额定交付交流容量与8760小时的乘积
notes: Combines availability outages and operating constraints; not a measured forecast.
notes_zh: 综合可用率停机与运行约束；并非实测预测。

denominator_definition: Full operating years after commissioning
denominator_definition_zh: 调试完成后的完整运行年数
notes: Engineering retirement and economic life are simplified into one duration.
notes_zh: 工程退役与经济寿命被简化为同一时长。

denominator_definition: Discounting from start of construction t=0
denominator_definition_zh: 从建设开始t=0时点贴现
notes: Not an observed SBSP WACC; tax financing tranches and inflation are excluded.
notes_zh: 并非实测SBSP加权资本成本；不含税务融资分层与通胀。

denominator_definition: Years from valuation base to commissioning
denominator_definition_zh: 从估值基准时点至调试完成的年数
notes: Default uses equal annual spend shares; project-specific scheduling is not represented.
notes_zh: 默认采用年度等额支出；未体现项目特定进度。

denominator_definition: Year-on-year reduction in delivered AC energy after the first operating year
denominator_definition_zh: 首个运行年后交付交流电量的逐年降幅
notes: Simplified fleet-average degradation proxy.
notes_zh: 简化的系统平均衰减代理。

denominator_definition: Complete operational orbital hardware mass per kW delivered AC at the grid boundary
denominator_definition_zh: 每千瓦并网交流交付功率对应的完整在轨运行硬件质量
notes: Delivered-power basis; never divide by efficiency again. Published values can be architecture-specific or manufacturer-claimed.
notes_zh: 交付功率口径；不得再次除以效率。公开数值可能取决于架构或来自厂商声明。

denominator_definition: Space DC-bus rated output excluding RF transmitter hardware
denominator_definition_zh: 空间直流母线额定输出且不含射频发射硬件
notes: Includes collection structure conversion and DC conditioning only; boundary is mutually exclusive with transmitter cost.
notes_zh: 仅含采集结构转换和直流调理；与发射机成本边界互斥。

denominator_definition: Emitted RF rated power excluding generation and DC-bus hardware
denominator_definition_zh: 射频额定发射功率且不含发电与直流母线硬件
notes: Includes only DC-to-RF and aperture hardware; no generation hardware is counted here.
notes_zh: 仅含直流至射频转换和发射孔径硬件；不重复计入发电硬件。

display_name: Launch service cost to staging orbit
display_name_zh: 至集结轨道发射服务成本
denominator_definition: Operational orbital hardware mass delivered to the defined LEO staging boundary
denominator_definition_zh: 交付至指定近地集结轨道边界的运行轨道硬件质量
notes: Not a GEO delivery quotation; procurement cadence integration and destination materially affect price.
notes_zh: 并非地球同步轨道交付报价；采购节奏集成与目的轨道会显著影响价格。

denominator_definition: One mutually exclusive launch flight to the staging orbit
denominator_definition_zh: 一次至集结轨道且与按公斤计价互斥的发射
notes: Used only when per-flight mode is active; never added to per-kg launch cost.
notes_zh: 仅在按次计价模式启用时使用；绝不与按公斤成本相加。

denominator_definition: Maximum manifested hardware mass reaching the staging orbit per flight
denominator_definition_zh: 每次到达集结轨道的最大配载硬件质量
notes: Vehicle and orbit dependent; used for launch-count diagnostics in both modes.
notes_zh: 取决于运载器与轨道；两种计价模式均用于发射次数诊断。

denominator_definition: Average used fraction of effective payload capability
denominator_definition_zh: 有效载荷能力的平均使用比例
notes: Does not model packaging volume schedule or rideshare constraints.
notes_zh: 未建模包装体积进度或拼单限制。

display_name_zh: 集结至运行轨道转移成本
denominator_definition: Final operational hardware moved from staging orbit to operational orbit
denominator_definition_zh: 从集结轨道转移至运行轨道的最终运行硬件
notes: Must cover transfer vehicle propellant refuelling missions operations and payload penalty; a low value does not prove cheap HEO delivery.
notes_zh: 必须覆盖转移器推进剂补给任务运行及载荷惩罚；低值不能证明高轨交付低廉。

denominator_definition: Operational orbital hardware assembled deployed and commissioned
denominator_definition_zh: 完成组装部署与调试的运行轨道硬件
notes: Exploratory allowance; robotic operations inspection spares and commissioning are bundled.
notes_zh: 探索性预留；机器人作业检查备件和调试被捆绑处理。

denominator_definition: Rated AC power delivered at the grid boundary
denominator_definition_zh: 并网边界额定交流交付功率
notes: Bundled proxy; antenna area frequency beam geometry sidelobes power-density land weather and safety are not explicit.
notes_zh: 捆绑代理；未显式建模天线面积频率波束几何旁瓣功率密度土地天气和安全。

denominator_definition: Rated AC power at the grid connection point
denominator_definition_zh: 并网点额定交流功率
notes: Simplified local connection allowance; wider transmission reinforcement is excluded.
notes_zh: 简化的本地并网预留；不含更广泛输电网增强。

denominator_definition: Applied once to pre-contingency initial construction CAPEX
denominator_definition_zh: 仅一次应用于预备费前初始建设资本开支
notes: Not applied recursively to annual O&M or replacement allowances.
notes_zh: 不递归应用于年度运维或更换预留。

denominator_definition: Fraction of eligible space hardware plus associated launch transfer and assembly cost replaced each year
denominator_definition_zh: 每年更换的合格空间硬件及其相关发射转移和组装成本比例
notes: Simplified annual equivalent rather than discrete failure and logistics scheduling.
notes_zh: 以简化年度等效方式处理而非离散故障与物流排程。

denominator_definition: Fraction of eligible rectenna and grid cost replaced each year
denominator_definition_zh: 每年更换的合格整流天线与并网成本比例
notes: Does not model component-specific replacement intervals.
notes_zh: 未建模各部件特定更换周期。

denominator_definition: Applied to generation transmitter rectenna and grid assets only
denominator_definition_zh: 仅应用于发电发射整流天线和并网资产
notes: Excludes contingency initial launch transfer and assembly from its base.
notes_zh: 其基数不含预备费初始发射转移和组装。

denominator_definition: Each MWh of AC energy delivered at the grid boundary
denominator_definition_zh: 并网边界每兆瓦时交流交付电量
notes: Exploratory allowance; market charges and downstream system costs are excluded.
notes_zh: 探索性预留；不含市场费用及下游系统成本。

denominator_definition: Applied at the end of operating life to initial CAPEX
denominator_definition_zh: 运行寿命结束时应用于初始资本开支
notes: Timing and disposal obligations are simplified.
notes_zh: 时点与处置义务被简化。

denominator_definition: Credit at end of operating life relative to initial CAPEX
denominator_definition_zh: 运行寿命结束时相对于初始资本开支的抵扣
notes: No default credit; salvage markets and liabilities are uncertain.
notes_zh: 默认无残值抵扣；回收市场与责任存在不确定性。
